name: Latvian Open Data Portal (data.gov.lv)
summary: Latvia's national open data portal, including the Register of Enterprises' company register, officers, members, beneficial owners, insolvencies and annual-report financials, queryable row by row.
notes: Keyless for public data. The portal runs CKAN: every action is /api/3/action/{name}, and help_show?name={action} on the portal returns that action's documentation.
Responses are {help, success, result}; on failure success is false and error replaces result, sometimes with HTTP 200, so check success.
The API lives under /dati on the host (https://data.gov.lv/dati/api/3/action/...). Metadata and field names are in Latvian.

The Register of Enterprises (organization ur) publishes its registers as DataStore resources: the company register (dataset uz, resource 25e80bf3-f107-4ab4-89ef-251b5b9374e9, filter on regcode, the 11-digit registration number), officers (dataset officers), LLC members (members), beneficial owners (patiesie-labuma-guveji), insolvency proceedings (maksatnespejas-procesi), historical names and annual-report financial data (gada-parskatu-finansu-dati). Get each one's current resource id with datasets.get.

endpoints.name: Search datasets
endpoints.summary: Datasets matching a Solr query and filters, with their resources and, optionally, facets.

fq.description: Solr filter query, e.g. organization:<name> or res_format:CSV.

sort.description: Comma-separated field and order; 'score desc, metadata_modified desc' by default.

rows.description: Datasets to return; 10 by default, at most 1000 unless the site sets otherwise.

start.description: Offset of the first dataset returned.

facet_field.description: JSON list of fields to facet on, e.g. ["organization","res_format"].

notes: result.count is the total; page with start and rows.

endpoints.name: Get a dataset
endpoints.summary: Metadata of one dataset and its resources (files and API links), including when each was last modified.

endpoints.name: Get a resource
endpoints.summary: Metadata of one resource: URL, format, size, last-modified time and whether its rows are queryable in the DataStore.
notes: datastore_active true means rows.search works on it; otherwise download the url.

endpoints.name: Query rows of a tabular resource
endpoints.summary: Rows of a DataStore-loaded resource, filtered by exact field values or full-text search, with field names and types.

q.description: Full-text query across all fields (or an object of {field: text}).

fields.description: Fields to return; all by default.

sort.description: Comma-separated fields with order, e.g. 'name asc'.

limit.description: Rows to return; 100 by default, at most 32000 unless the site sets otherwise.

include_total.description: Return the total matching count; true by default.

notes: A read over POST (CKAN accepts every action as a JSON POST). Only resources with datastore_active true can be queried.

endpoints.name: List publishing organizations
endpoints.summary: The organizations that publish datasets on the portal, as names or with details and dataset counts.

all_fields.description: Return organization objects (with package_count) instead of names.

sort.description: name, package_count or title, with asc or desc; 'title asc' by default.

limit.description: Organizations to return; 1000 by default for names, 25 with all_fields.
